lesson.menu_desc: Calling the security vendor to open a ticket: what users can't do and what you need -- can / can't
lesson.subtitle: Lesson 3 -- Opening a Ticket
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Diogo Campos Silva | Lesson 3 -- Opening a Ticket
lesson.grammar_point: can / can't (ability and requests: I can't log in, Can you help me?)

listenings.text: Welcome to SecureNet Support. For a new ticket, press one. If you can't log in to your account, press two. To reset your password, press three. Our analysts can help you twenty-four hours a day, seven days a week. You can also open a ticket on our website.

Hello, Diogo, this is Ravi from SecureNet. I can see your ticket, number six one nine. I can't reset the server now, but I can do it tonight at ten. Today your users can work from the office, but they can't use the VPN from home. I can call you tomorrow at nine. Thank you.

extra_audio.text: Twenty users can't log in to the VPN. Diogo calls SecureNet Support. Linda asks: Can they access the internet? Diogo says: Yes, they can. Linda says: I can reset the VPN for you.
